programme.title: Flags Of Our Fathers
programme.desc: Filmmaking legends Spielberg and Eastwood collaborate on a gripping portrayal of the WWII battle for Iwo Jima, focusing on the iconic flag-raising image and the tragic loss of life on both sides.

programme.title: Long Live Robin Hood
programme.desc: This Italian-made retelling of the Robin Hood legend follows Sir Henry of Nottingham as he returns from the Crusades to find England under Prince John's rule, and leads a daring revolt to restore justice and crown King Richard.

programme.title: U-96, The True Story Of Das Boot
programme.desc: The international success of the film Das Boot made the U-96 the most famous of all Hitler's submarines and the best-known movie submarine. But the true story of this extraordinary submarine and its equally exceptional crew goes far beyond fiction.

programme.title: The Eagle Huntress
programme.desc: This spell-binding documentary follows Aisholpan, a 13-year-old nomadic Mongolian girl who is fighting to become the first female eagle hunter in twelve generations of her Kazakh family. Through breathtaking aerial cinematography and intimate verite footage, the film captures her personal journey while also addressing universal themes like female empowerment, the natural world, coming of age and the onset of modernity.

programme.title: Finding Altamira
programme.desc: In 1879, a Spanish archaeologist and his eight-year-old daughter cause worldwide controversy when they discover cave paintings that are 10,000 years old. The discovery will put the family at odds with the religious and scientific leaders of the day. Directed by Hugh Hudson and stars Antonio Banderas, Clement Sibony and Golshifteh Farahani.

programme.title: Home Song Stories
programme.desc: Rose Hong (Joan Chen) is a Hong Kong nightclub singer who emigrates to Australia with her sailor husband, Bill (Steven Vidler), and her two children. The couple's relationship doesn't last long, but they attempt to reconcile after several years.

programme.title: The Queen Of My Dreams
programme.desc: Azra is worlds apart from her conservative Muslim mother. When her father suddenly dies on a trip home to Pakistan, Azra finds herself on a Bollywood-inspired journey through memories, both real and imagined; from her mother's youth in Karachi to her own coming-of-age in rural Canada.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Marie's Story
programme.desc: After a tragic accident, Marie struggles to rebuild her life and rediscover hope, confronting grief, forgiveness, and the power of human connection in this moving drama.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: Exploring the history of the Spitfire airplane in commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary. Directed by David Fairhead and Ant Palmer, starring John Ackroyd, Charles Dance, Mary Ellis.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: Deep in the Lapland wilderness during the final days of World War II, a solitary prospector strikes gold and sets out on a perilous journey to cash in his find. When a retreating Nazi unit attempts to steal his fortune, they discover they have targeted a man of extraordinary resilience. What follows is a brutal, darkly entertaining battle of survival, revenge and determination against impossible odds.

programme.title: The Flowers Of War
programme.desc: In 1937 China, during the second Sino-Japanese war, a mortician, John (Christian Bale) arrives at a Catholic church in Nanjing to prepare a priest for burial. Upon arrival he finds himself the lone adult among a group of convent girl students and prostitutes from a nearby brothel.

programme.title: The Flowers Of War
programme.desc: In 1937 China, during the second Sino-Japanese war, a mortician, John (Christian Bale) arrives at a Catholic church in Nanjing to prepare a priest for burial. Upon arrival he finds himself the lone adult among a group of convent girl students and prostitutes from a nearby brothel.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Follows the haunting story of a young university student who begins a freelance job where she is sedated and sleeps in bed with paying customers, unaware of what they have done to her when she awakes. The film is the directorial debut of Julia Leigh and won several awards around the world, including Best Direction in a Feature at the Australian Directors Guild in 2012. Stars Emily Browning, Rachel Blake and Ewen Leslie.

programme.title: Vera And The Pleasure Of Others
programme.desc: 17-year-old Vera is bored with her life. She divides her days between volleyball and school, plus a secret hobby - she rents out an empty apartment to teenagers looking for a place to have sex.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Movie review program hosted by Margaret Pomeranz & David Stratton. In this episode they review Man On the Moon, Dogma. Featuring performances from Linda Fiorentino, Alan Rickman and Ben Affleck. Later, they review Not One Less, Felicia's Journey and Romance.

programme.title: Emu Runner
programme.desc: Gem, a spirited young girl, deals with the grief of her mother's death by forging a bond with a wild emu. This spiritual dreaming is a bond she will do anything to keep, but one that puts her at odds with the new social worker. Directed by Imogen Thomas and stars Rhae-Kye Waites and Wayne Blair.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: Exploring the history of the Spitfire airplane in commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary. Directed by David Fairhead and Ant Palmer, starring John Ackroyd, Charles Dance, Mary Ellis.

programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: Step into the golden age of Hollywood with Billy Bright, a slapstick legend whose rise to fame is as hilarious as his downfall is shocking. Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

programme.title: Empty Nets
programme.desc: Amir and Narges share a secret love on the Caspian coast, but social class and strict tradition stand in their way. Determined to win her family's approval and afford a dowry, Amir turns to dangerous work at a fishery and becomes entangled in black-market caviar smuggling. As his choices compromise his values and Narges delays the arranged marriage her parents expect, the two fight to protect their future against a web of pressure, corruption, and hierarchy that still defines life for Iran's younger generation.

programme.title: House Of The Seasons
programme.desc: It's summer, and the whole Kim family have gathered in Daegu for the ancestral rites. This includes Seong-jin, the eldest grandson of the family, whose father has taken on the family business: a tofu factory. After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

programme.title: Long Live Robin Hood
programme.desc: This Italian-made retelling of the Robin Hood legend follows Sir Henry of Nottingham as he returns from the Crusades to find England under Prince John's rule, and leads a daring revolt to restore justice and crown King Richard.

programme.title: Shaolin Soccer
programme.desc: When a group of Shaolin monks fail in city life, they form a soccer team under the coaching of a disgraced soccer legend. Winner of six Hong Kong Film Awards in 2002, including Best Picture. Directed by and stars Stephen Chow. Also stars Man Tat Ng and Patrick Tse.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: In advance of a presidential visit to the small town of Suddenly, California, a trio of FBI agents enters the Benson family's home to assess potential security risks. Once inside, leader John Baron (Frank Sinatra) reveals himself as a psychopathic assassin, and he kidnaps the family in order to use their house as his vantage point in his plot to kill the president.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: Inspired by real photos from the Nanjing Massacre, 1937. During WWII in Nanjing, postman A-Chang is forced to work as a film developer for the Japanese army. Hidden in the photo studio, he shelters civilians while secretly smuggling out photos that expose the massacre to the world.

programme.title: Stockholm Bloodbath
programme.desc: In 1520, sisters Freja and Anne seek revenge amid King Christian II's ruthless quest for the Swedish crown, leading to the brutal Stockholm Bloodbath-a dark, action-packed true story

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary's tender braising recipes feel like kitchen magic, like braised blade steak and butter beans, or braised cabbage with crispy topping.

programme.title: Nigellissima Christmas
programme.desc: Nigella loves Christmas and for her a party is the perfect way to celebrate. This year, she kicks off festivities with a glittering buffet party in Nigellissima - an Italian inspired Christmas. For her Italian inspiration Nigella travels to Venice, a city that's been close to her heart ever since her first visit 20 years ago. Armed with recipe and party ideas for her festive feast, Nigella returns to create a tasty Christmas buffet menu for her guests.

programme.title: A Berry Royal Christmas
programme.desc: The Duchess of Cambridge and Mary will travel to Liverpool to visit The Brink the UK's first dry bar set up by Action on Addiction, that provides a safe space for people suffering from addiction.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony embarks on a pilgrimage to Sydney, Australia so he may indulge in a meal made by one of the world's best chefs - Tetsuya Wakuda.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain: A Cook's Tour
programme.sub-title: Singapore: New York In Twenty Years
programme.desc: Tony sets out to find the real Singapore, with its multicultural restaurants and food markets. He samples prescription food dishes and explores the Geyland Serai Marke.

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programme.desc: It's Easy Entertaining, and designer Jamie Durie and chef Annie Smithers join Adam for The Provincial French Picnic.

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Learn how to butcher a whole pheasant and utilize the boneless meat for pheasant skewers basted with ginger juice and yakitori glaze.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In Italy, a leisure lunch is just as important as dinner. Lidia shares ideas to make the American tradition more Italian; prosciutto cotto salad, cherry jam tart, and a scallion egg sandwich.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: The Netherlands is the second largest exporter of cheese in Europe after France, yet it’s famous for just two cheeses, Edam and Gouda. Will visits the town of Edam to see what it once looked like before it was covered in red wax, before visiting a slow food show in Rotterdam where he discovers a number of interesting traditional cheeses which the Dutch keep for themselves. After learning how real farmhouse Gouda and its cousins are made Will travels to the beautiful island of Texel to look at a cheese that was once coloured green with sheep droppings.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: As the final stanza in Warren's Food Trail of South Africa, he's back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera
programme.desc: As the world capital of perfume, Grasse opens the doors to its most treasured secrets.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Situated north of Scotland, living on this collection of eighteen islands has always be a struggle for survival.

programme.title: Kriol Kitchen
programme.sub-title: Baked Turkey, Baked Kangaroo Sausage, Kangaroo Steaks With Bush Koonkaberry Sauce, Roo Tail Stew
programme.desc: Time for some traditional inspired cooking. In this food adventure Ali and Mitch meet up with their cousin Ronnie Jimbidie at his tourism business Girlooloo Tours based at the spectacular Mimbi Caves.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: Preparing for Christmas in June is not the norm for most of us, but for Maggie and Simon it’s the ideal time to plan ahead and ‘put down’ some ingredients to mature nicely for the festive season. Maggie discovers a few plum pudding secrets and shows us how to make the fruit filling for her deliciously rich ‘mini’ mince pies. At this time of year Simon’s into pickling, starting with an old favourite the pickled onion.

programme.title: My Market Kitchen
programme.desc: Laura is in the beautiful Adelaide Hills, cooking a very healthy and tasty Middle Eastern Cauliflower Salad.

programme.title: Luca's Key Ingredient

programme.title: Strait To The Plate

programme.title: My Market Kitchen

programme.title: Sachie's Kitchen
programme.desc: Henry Onesemo, head chef at Tala restaurant, grew up in Samoa. His passion for food started when he was young. The Samoan word tala means story or tale. For Henry, Tala is where he tells his tales of Samoa through familiar ingredients presented with a fresh twist.

When her father suddenly dies on a trip home to Pakistan, Azra finds herself on a Bollywood-inspired journey through memories, both real and imagined; from her mother's youth in Karachi to her own coming-of-age in rural Canada.

programme.title: What We Did On Our Holiday
programme.desc: Doug and Abi take their kids on a family holiday. Surrounded by relatives, the kids innocently reveal the ins and outs of their family life and many intimate details about their parents. It's soon clear that when it comes to keeping a big secret under wraps from the rest of the family, their children are their biggest liability. Stars David Tennant and Rosamund Pike.

programme.title: Marie's Story
programme.desc: After a tragic accident, Marie struggles to rebuild her life and rediscover hope, confronting grief, forgiveness, and the power of human connection in this moving drama.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: Exploring the history of the Spitfire airplane in commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary. Directed by David Fairhead and Ant Palmer, starring John Ackroyd, Charles Dance, Mary Ellis.

programme.title: Sisu
programme.desc: Deep in the Lapland wilderness during the final days of World War II, a solitary prospector strikes gold and sets out on a perilous journey to cash in his find. When a retreating Nazi unit attempts to steal his fortune, they discover they have targeted a man of extraordinary resilience. What follows is a brutal, darkly entertaining battle of survival, revenge and determination against impossible odds.

programme.title: The Flowers Of War
programme.desc: In 1937 China, during the second Sino-Japanese war, a mortician, John (Christian Bale) arrives at a Catholic church in Nanjing to prepare a priest for burial. Upon arrival he finds himself the lone adult among a group of convent girl students and prostitutes from a nearby brothel.

programme.title: The Flowers Of War
programme.desc: In 1937 China, during the second Sino-Japanese war, a mortician, John (Christian Bale) arrives at a Catholic church in Nanjing to prepare a priest for burial. Upon arrival he finds himself the lone adult among a group of convent girl students and prostitutes from a nearby brothel.

programme.title: Sleeping Beauty
programme.desc: Follows the haunting story of a young university student who begins a freelance job where she is sedated and sleeps in bed with paying customers, unaware of what they have done to her when she awakes. The film is the directorial debut of Julia Leigh and won several awards around the world, including Best Direction in a Feature at the Australian Directors Guild in 2012. Stars Emily Browning, Rachel Blake and Ewen Leslie.

programme.title: Vera And The Pleasure Of Others
programme.desc: 17-year-old Vera is bored with her life. She divides her days between volleyball and school, plus a secret hobby - she rents out an empty apartment to teenagers looking for a place to have sex.

programme.title: The Movie Show
programme.desc: Movie review program hosted by Margaret Pomeranz & David Stratton. In this episode they review Man On the Moon, Dogma. Featuring performances from Linda Fiorentino, Alan Rickman and Ben Affleck. Later, they review Not One Less, Felicia's Journey and Romance.

programme.title: Emu Runner
programme.desc: Gem, a spirited young girl, deals with the grief of her mother's death by forging a bond with a wild emu. This spiritual dreaming is a bond she will do anything to keep, but one that puts her at odds with the new social worker. Directed by Imogen Thomas and stars Rhae-Kye Waites and Wayne Blair.

programme.title: Spitfire
programme.desc: Exploring the history of the Spitfire airplane in commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary. Directed by David Fairhead and Ant Palmer, starring John Ackroyd, Charles Dance, Mary Ellis.

programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: Step into the golden age of Hollywood with Billy Bright, a slapstick legend whose rise to fame is as hilarious as his downfall is shocking. Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

programme.title: Empty Nets
programme.desc: Amir and Narges share a secret love on the Caspian coast, but social class and strict tradition stand in their way. Determined to win her family's approval and afford a dowry, Amir turns to dangerous work at a fishery and becomes entangled in black-market caviar smuggling. As his choices compromise his values and Narges delays the arranged marriage her parents expect, the two fight to protect their future against a web of pressure, corruption, and hierarchy that still defines life for Iran's younger generation.

programme.title: House Of The Seasons
programme.desc: It's summer, and the whole Kim family have gathered in Daegu for the ancestral rites. This includes Seong-jin, the eldest grandson of the family, whose father has taken on the family business: a tofu factory. After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

programme.title: Long Live Robin Hood
programme.desc: This Italian-made retelling of the Robin Hood legend follows Sir Henry of Nottingham as he returns from the Crusades to find England under Prince John's rule, and leads a daring revolt to restore justice and crown King Richard.

programme.title: Shaolin Soccer
programme.desc: When a group of Shaolin monks fail in city life, they form a soccer team under the coaching of a disgraced soccer legend. Winner of six Hong Kong Film Awards in 2002, including Best Picture. Directed by and stars Stephen Chow. Also stars Man Tat Ng and Patrick Tse.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: In advance of a presidential visit to the small town of Suddenly, California, a trio of FBI agents enters the Benson family's home to assess potential security risks. Once inside, leader John Baron (Frank Sinatra) reveals himself as a psychopathic assassin, and he kidnaps the family in order to use their house as his vantage point in his plot to kill the president.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: Inspired by real photos from the Nanjing Massacre, 1937. During WWII in Nanjing, postman A-Chang is forced to work as a film developer for the Japanese army. Hidden in the photo studio, he shelters civilians while secretly smuggling out photos that expose the massacre to the world.

programme.title: Stockholm Bloodbath
programme.desc: In 1520, sisters Freja and Anne seek revenge amid King Christian II's ruthless quest for the Swedish crown, leading to the brutal Stockholm Bloodbath-a dark, action-packed true story

programme.title: Mary Makes It Easy
programme.desc: Mary's tender braising recipes feel like kitchen magic, like braised blade steak and butter beans, or braised cabbage with crispy topping.

programme.title: Nigellissima Christmas
programme.desc: Nigella loves Christmas and for her a party is the perfect way to celebrate. This year, she kicks off festivities with a glittering buffet party in Nigellissima - an Italian inspired Christmas. For her Italian inspiration Nigella travels to Venice, a city that's been close to her heart ever since her first visit 20 years ago. Armed with recipe and party ideas for her festive feast, Nigella returns to create a tasty Christmas buffet menu for her guests.

programme.sub-title: Singapore: New York In Twenty Years

programme.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw

programme.title: Andrew Zimmern's Wild Game Kitchen
programme.desc: Learn how to butcher a whole pheasant and utilize the boneless meat for pheasant skewers basted with ginger juice and yakitori glaze.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: In Italy, a leisure lunch is just as important as dinner. Lidia shares ideas to make the American tradition more Italian; prosciutto cotto salad, cherry jam tart, and a scallion egg sandwich.

programme.title: Cheese Slices
programme.desc: The Netherlands is the second largest exporter of cheese in Europe after France, yet it’s famous for just two cheeses, Edam and Gouda. Will visits the town of Edam to see what it once looked like before it was covered in red wax, before visiting a slow food show in Rotterdam where he discovers a number of interesting traditional cheeses which the Dutch keep for themselves. After learning how real farmhouse Gouda and its cousins are made Will travels to the beautiful island of Texel to look at a cheese that was once coloured green with sheep droppings.

programme.title: Food Trail South Africa
programme.desc: As the final stanza in Warren's Food Trail of South Africa, he's back in the bush, a quintessential part of all travel to the rainbow nation.

programme.title: Dolce Vita Riviera

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery
programme.desc: Situated north of Scotland, living on this collection of eighteen islands has always be a struggle for survival.

programme.sub-title: Baked Turkey, Baked Kangaroo Sausage, Kangaroo Steaks With Bush Koonkaberry Sauce, Roo Tail Stew
programme.desc: Time for some traditional inspired cooking. In this food adventure Ali and Mitch meet up with their cousin Ronnie Jimbidie at his tourism business Girlooloo Tours based at the spectacular Mimbi Caves.

programme.title: The Cook And The Chef
programme.desc: Preparing for Christmas in June is not the norm for most of us, but for Maggie and Simon it’s the ideal time to plan ahead and ‘put down’ some ingredients to mature nicely for the festive season. Maggie discovers a few plum pudding secrets and shows us how to make the fruit filling for her deliciously rich ‘mini’ mince pies. At this time of year Simon’s into pickling, starting with an old favourite the pickled onion.

programme.desc: Exploring the history of the Spitfire airplane in commemoration of the Royal Air Force's centenary. Directed by David Fairhead and Ant Palmer, starring John Ackroyd, Charles Dance, Mary Ellis.

programme.title: The Comic
programme.desc: Step into the golden age of Hollywood with Billy Bright, a slapstick legend whose rise to fame is as hilarious as his downfall is shocking. Packed with sharp satire, big laughs, and a bittersweet look behind the curtain of showbiz, The Comic delivers a fast, funny, and unforgettable ride through the life of a comedy genius who just can’t get out of his own way. A must-see for film lovers and comedy fans alike.

programme.title: Empty Nets
programme.desc: Amir and Narges share a secret love on the Caspian coast, but social class and strict tradition stand in their way. Determined to win her family's approval and afford a dowry, Amir turns to dangerous work at a fishery and becomes entangled in black-market caviar smuggling. As his choices compromise his values and Narges delays the arranged marriage her parents expect, the two fight to protect their future against a web of pressure, corruption, and hierarchy that still defines life for Iran's younger generation.

programme.title: House Of The Seasons
programme.desc: It's summer, and the whole Kim family have gathered in Daegu for the ancestral rites. This includes Seong-jin, the eldest grandson of the family, whose father has taken on the family business: a tofu factory. After the rites, family tensions start to rise and Seong-jin drops the bombshell that he won’t be taking on the family business.

programme.title: Long Live Robin Hood
programme.desc: This Italian-made retelling of the Robin Hood legend follows Sir Henry of Nottingham as he returns from the Crusades to find England under Prince John's rule, and leads a daring revolt to restore justice and crown King Richard.

programme.title: Shaolin Soccer
programme.desc: When a group of Shaolin monks fail in city life, they form a soccer team under the coaching of a disgraced soccer legend. Winner of six Hong Kong Film Awards in 2002, including Best Picture. Directed by and stars Stephen Chow. Also stars Man Tat Ng and Patrick Tse.

programme.title: Suddenly
programme.desc: In advance of a presidential visit to the small town of Suddenly, California, a trio of FBI agents enters the Benson family's home to assess potential security risks. Once inside, leader John Baron (Frank Sinatra) reveals himself as a psychopathic assassin, and he kidnaps the family in order to use their house as his vantage point in his plot to kill the president.

programme.title: Dead To Rights
programme.desc: Inspired by real photos from the Nanjing Massacre, 1937. During WWII in Nanjing, postman A-Chang is forced to work as a film developer for the Japanese army. Hidden in the photo studio, he shelters civilians while secretly smuggling out photos that expose the massacre to the world.

programme.title: Stockholm Bloodbath
programme.desc: In 1520, sisters Freja and Anne seek revenge amid King Christian II's ruthless quest for the Swedish crown, leading to the brutal Stockholm Bloodbath-a dark, action-packed true story
